name: Pass 23 quality-certificate hardening
goal: Ensure quality certificates cannot claim stage acceptance without reviewer, score, panel, refinery, evidence, and residual-risk proof.
risks: A template-like quality certificate could be issued as stage proof
Certificate reviewer scores could belong to unlisted reviewers
A certificate could omit its refinery gate or lower its threshold

nodes.label: Pass 23 certificate critic review

node_contract.what: Review quality certificate enforcement against transcript requirements.
node_contract.why: Certificates are the stage acceptance boundary and must not be decorative.
node_contract.how: Inspect templates, skills, runner coverage, and validator gaps.
node_contract.where: df-quality-refinery skill, certificate template, validation runner, and pass 22 residual risks.
node_contract.who: Codex using governance, quality, and verification expert lenses.
node_contract.how_good: Findings are concrete, reproducible, and closed with regression checks.

nodes.feedback_loop: Each finding becomes validator logic and a hardening-runner negative fixture.

nodes.label: Certificate validator implementation

node_contract.what: Add and wire executable quality-certificate validation.
node_contract.why: Future certificates need enforceable proof before acceptance.
node_contract.how: Create validate_quality_certificate.py, update template and skill guidance, sync workspace, add fixtures.
node_contract.where: df-quality-refinery installed skill and workspace bundle.
node_contract.when: After critic review and before evidence closure.
node_contract.how_good: Positive certificate passes and weak certificates fail.

nodes.feedback_loop: Rerun the full hardening suite after every validator change.
gates: positive and negative fixtures behave as expected

nodes.label: Pass 23 verification sweep

node_contract.why: The certificate hardening only counts if the runner and merged records prove it.
node_contract.how: Run hardening suite, merged-record validation, hash sync, JSON, ASCII, and artifact ID checks.
node_contract.where: Workspace validation suite and pass 23 records.
node_contract.when: After all fixes and records are written.
node_contract.how_good: All checks pass and residual risks remain explicit.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any failed check reopens the fix node.
